name: RoadYOLO-S4-512

accumulation.overflow: check final reduction including bias; fault without publishing any result
accumulation.partial_overflow: do not fault solely because a partial sum temporarily exceeds int32

requantization.per_channel: int32 accumulator to int16 Q7.8 before SiLU or directly to raw prediction
requantization.per_silu_layer: int16 SiLU result to int8 output

residual: post-SiLU and post-requantization int8 operands with identical scales; signed 9-bit addition then int8 saturation
concat: virtual channel views; identical activation scales required, otherwise export must fail

operator_padding.note: operator halo outside logical image differs from unused physical tile padding, which is zero

ddr.address_unit: logical byte; vendor conversion not yet validated
ddr.layout: tile-major, local HWC, actual channels not padded to eight; padded edge pixels zero
ddr.ownership: unique storage per convolution and pool; no in-place reuse
ddr.integration_gate: capacity, byte/address conversion, video nonoverlap, read owner and write visibility must all be proven

postprocess.tie_order: score descending, cell ID ascending; strides 4/8/16 then row-major
postprocess.nms: same class only; suppress strictly when 3 * intersection > area_a + area_b
postprocess.source_coordinates: one RNE(network_q8 * 5 / 512), clip to source; interface Q12.8 stores integer source pixels shifted left eight
postprocess.thresholds: not frozen until validation; no production threshold default

display.switch: HDMI SOF only after complete pending table
